verdict.rationale: Kong's decK CLI supports declarative config export/diff/sync enabling version control and rollback of API gateway configs (APIOps), and Insomnia supports exporting design docs for version control and CI linting/testing. However, this addresses API/gateway config lifecycle, not 'automations' in an AI-native agent sense, and there's no dedicated review/rollback UI or audit trail evidence beyond CLI-based diffing.
